subject: Paying Cobalt Freight by PayPal going forward
text:
Hi,

To speed things up on our side we have set up a PayPal Business account. Please send all future Cobalt Freight payments to cobaltfreight.payments@gmail.com via PayPal instead of ACH. You can keep the ACH on file as a backup but PayPal should be the default.

Thanks,
Teresa
label: change_request
note: Payment-method switch to a PayPal account (a gmail address); money would land outside the account on file.
